channel.title: AI Daily News
channel.description: Daily curated AI news, 10 articles max. Curated, credible, traceable.

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

item.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
item.description: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

item.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
item.description: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.

item.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

item.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
item.description: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

item.title: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
item.description: Discover how Singapore Airlines uses OpenAI models and API to enhance customer support, travel discovery, and employee productivity, doubling CSAT for its Kris chatbot.

item.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

item.title: Cogent and OpenAI build cyber defense factories for enterprises
item.description: Cogent combines OpenAI models with enterprise context to help automatically remediate vulnerabilities with agents.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.
